notes.title: Kyle is COMPLETE
notes.content:
[i][h1]Hey everyone![/h1][/i]
[i][h2]It's a BIG day for Kyle. You see, Kyle is now... COMPLETE[/h2][/i]
[previewyoutube=6oi9ParvI8g;full][/previewyoutube]
Back in 2019 when Ducky released [i]Kyle is Famous[/i] as a fun, free project here on Steam, he had no idea how popular it would get and how much people would love Kyle.

So he came to us at New Blood and said... do you want to make Kyle... Complete? And we said... 
[b]YES OF COURSE WHATEVER THAT MEANS WE'RE 100% IN.[/b]

[b]BEHOLD...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/1ca1272349d5dce4e21f888d3c257b9a5acce62c.jpg[/img]

The [b]COMPLETE[/b] Edition of [i]Kyle is Famous[/i] now includes:
[list]
[*] [b]More than 117 endings + All the original Kyle DLC[/b] (You're a hot dog!)
[*] [b]Over 2000+ lines of voice acted dialogue by Gianni[/b] ([url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCjWsE9cjRu5gImk99yFhwVg]He's funny![/url])
[*] [b]A custom story editor with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1186740/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url][/b] (Oh boy, mods!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/e518a29ab6972cc1334cf81b61e88ba2277f6d66.png[/img]
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/ducky_dev]Twitch plays Kyle[/url]?!)
[*] [b]Tons of new visuals, sounds, and more![/b] (Shazam!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/02ac46db5a43f42c3098e17165b5f3ee42104bbc.jpg[/img]
[/list]But wait... [i]there's more![/i]

Everyone who had the original [b]FREE[/b] version of Kyle has now been [b]UPGRADED[/b] to the [i][b]Kyle is Famous: Free Edition.[/b][/i] It's kinda the same... but different! And [i]better![/i]

This version of the game has all the content of the old version but looks and plays like the Complete Edition! [i]But no new endings, voice acting or fancy new features.[/i] It does have Twitch integration though! And of course you can still play all your original Kyle DLC. [b]UPGRADE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/3fc60dd7961d036891e70f980354c777d9c917e2.jpg[/img]

Speaking of those of you who want to UPGRADE to the COMPLETE EDITION of Kyle, know that Steam might give you this warning about that - but rest assured you can mash your face into the [b]PURCHASE[/b] button and it will indeed give you the shiny new version of Kyle. [i]We promise.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/8d5c976e884e9b58e8c7179e4b34652a7702379d.png[/img]

Thank you so much for supporting Kyle, Ducky and New Blood as we made Kyle... [i]Complete[/i]. If you love Kyle as much as we love Kyle, be sure to tell a friend, family member, or your favorite loud mouthed internet celebrity, [b]Kyle would love that.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186740/Kyle_is_Famous_Complete_Edition/

notes.title: New Endings: Ghostly Edition
notes.content:
[h2]Hey guys! New endings have been added to Kyle is Famous![/h2]

I've added in a new set of endings relating to withering away while in bed. I've always thought that part of the game was a little lacking, and now it's been fleshed out to give some extra dimension to that choice. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/8a916771ae2bfafb7d31495952233e20c18f4fc8.gif[/img]

This is set #2 of gradual updates to the game that I've been making! I think I might add some more endings to the ghost track later down the line depending on how people enjoy them.

If you missed it before, I also recently added in a new set of endings inside of the interview where Kyle decides that he's going to become. . . Rachel May herself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/fa732300af4fe2f6937582d2f1eb9e810410abf0.gif[/img]

Hope you guys like the new content! Keep posted for more!
- John

notes.title: Kyle is Hotdog - RELEASED TO THE WORLD!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Kyle is Hotdog has RELEASED!!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/fd7413d663f001caf9a81472c137e73e0b05c617.png[/img]

Kyle has woken up today and realized something incredibly important. Kyle is bored, [b]and is ready for something new and exciting to enter his life.[/b] Kyle decides to pursue his childhood passion of hotdog sales, preparing instead for a day on the streets instead of an interview with Rachel.

[b]22 New Endings. . .[/b]
Kyle is Hotdog expands Kyle's pre-existing world to include 22 new endings, including the eating of the entire leprechaun pit, moving Tyler around from inside of himself to boost hotdog sales, traveling to foreign dimensions, writing love letters to old high-school crushes. . . [b]and maybe, if you look hard enough, a little look into Kyle's character himself. . . (but you didn't hear that from me).[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/5896f0e0e7e1ed6075e46d3855871fd6462a5fda.gif[/img]

[b]Available Now!!![/b]
Kyle is Hotdog is [b]available to play now[/b] for roughly the price of a hotdog. This was something I made from a love of the project and the characters, and I am SO excited for you all to crawl through and find all the secrets I've hidden around. :)

Go give it a look! :) I love each and every one of you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263080/Kyle_is_Hotdog/

notes.title: Kyle is Santa - Holiday Expansion | Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Kyle's Expanded Adventure. . .[/h1]
Kyle wakes up, realizing that he now can be imbued with the spirit of Christmas. After spewing elves out of his stomach and being tormented with the voices of children, Kyle walks through his world with a [b]new set of goals.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36125113/045560eebcd5246045b18e2ee4aa120918dcff4d.png[/img]

[h1]11 New Endings and More. . .[/h1]
Kyle has [b]11 new holiday-centered endings[/b] to explore. Release elves upon the world, give gifts to the kids, and possibly even conduct an interview as. . . someone new? New interactions with old characters and items included.

[h1]Alpha Access[/h1]
Kyle is Santa is planned for release on Steam [b]December 13th.[/b] However, if you want to play RIGHT NOW, Kyle is Santa is already released in alpha on my [url=https://www.patreon.com/szymanski]Patreon.[/url] Feel free to check it out, or drop by the Steam page below!

-------------------

Thanks so much for the incredibly warm and happy reception of Kyle is Famous onto Steam. I really hope you guys like this expansion and have a great time being Santa!

-John
